Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FINISHED PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENT TEXTURE for a premium 2.5D casual toy stacking mobile game, title Zhe Ye Neng Die (do not print title). Generate a single full-bleed portrait 9:16 image, ideally 1536 x 2730. This is one actual background asset, not a mockup, not a concept board.

A cheerful miniature modern city constructed from beautifully crafted satin toy plastic. Looking across a flat sunlit pale buttery-yellow plaza from near ground level. Blue, pale butter-yellow and restrained coral buildings frame ONLY the lower left and lower right edges. Buildings have broad rounded bevels, subtle molded seams, softly recessed cyan windows with diffuse depth, warm upper-left sun and soft realistic ambient occlusion; carefully finished dimensional toy diorama, crisp silhouettes without black outlines or noisy detail. A few tiny rounded greenery forms integrated at the sidewalks. Very distant simple blue city shapes visible behind the open central space, reduced contrast and lighter atmospheric color. No photoreal architecture, no medieval village. Match a blue-yellow premium toy-game world, delightful and calm.

COMPOSITION CRITICAL: upper 38 percent is a clean bright azure sky gradient. Tall near-side buildings start around 40 percent down at the extreme edges, no building intrudes into central 42 percent above y=65%. Bottom 20 percent is UNAMBIGUOUS FLAT GROUND PLAZA across the full width. Ground plane beautifully lit with a small number of broad gentle paving seams and warm diffuse shadows, no strong long diagonal grids competing with the separate gameplay platform. Central vertical corridor stays spacious, lower contrast and calm so separately rendered objects and HUD are always the focus. No giant central tower or landmark. World feels crafted, rounded and polished, not glossy stock-image chrome, not a flat vector illustration, not a gritty photo. Moderate saturation with detailed coherent lighting. All materials must feel considered and finished.

BACKGROUND LAYER REQUIREMENT: ABSOLUTELY NO CLOUDS anywhere, no haze patches shaped like clouds. Clouds will be independently animated sprites. No blimp, balloon, bird, plane, planets, stars, characters, text, logo, buttons, HUD, icons, frame, phone, watermark, tower, toys to stack or ground pedestal. Just cloud-free sky, cohesive low-contrast toy-city setting, and ground. Finished professional game art with no placeholder shapes.
purpose: Cloud-free city ground artwork; clouds are separate motion sprites.
